generationInputs.prompt: A vintage-style poster, inspired by 1950s beauty ads with a limited red-toned palette on a cream background, features a whimsical and slightly unsettling scene amidst a misty, dark background with sparkling diamonds. A stylized, engraved illustration of a luminous pink donut, almost ethereal and weightless with a holographic icing effect, is centrally depicted. Viscous, bright white liquid drips from the donut, and a small pinkish-red flower rests upon it. Tiny, brightly colored, translucent sprinkles are scattered across the icing. Beside it, an eggplant, also in an engraved illustration style, holds a syringe. The poster features a large, bold, witty headline arching across the top in all caps, with a tagline below, and scattered mid-century sparkle icons.
